meta.name: code-reviewing
meta.description: Review code for quality, security, and best practices. Use when the user asks for code review, wants feedback on their code, mentions reviewing changes, or asks about code quality.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码质量、安全与最佳实践
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在合并前获得代码改进建议
copy.tagline_en: Review code for quality, security, and best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need feedback on your code before merging

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照清单检查代码质量、安全性、性能和可维护性，并给出带严重等级的问题列表和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你要求审查代码、询问代码质量或提及需要反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段 Python 代码，看看有没有安全问题。
say.note: Claude 会按清单检查并输出报告。

say.text: 检查一下我的代码是否有重复或性能问题。
say.note: Claude 会重点审查代码质量和性能。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will review code against a checklist covering quality, security, performance, and maintainability, then output a structured report with issues by severity and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a code review, want feedback on your code, mention reviewing changes, or ask about code quality.

say_en.text: Review this Python code for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude will check the checklist and output a report.

say_en.text: Check my code for duplication or performance problems.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on code quality and performance.
